messages:
Nina (Partnerships): heads up 1 CloudSummit 50: AuroraCloud wants a joint stage demo + a marketplace launch blurb. Need speaker list, demo flow, press timing, and booth staff. who can own?
Diego (Solutions): I can run the live integration demo. thinking: 4-min marketplace provisioning, 6-min live inference on Aurora edge node. keep it simple.
Harper (Marketing): deadlines: bios+headshots by Mon EOD; press embargo window is Tues 9am PT; social kit needs to be ready 48h before.
Eli (Eng): demo infra: we should lock a pre-provisioned aurora VM and scripted teardown. will request 1x T4 and set IP allowlist. need partner VPN creds.
Jordan (Partner - AuroraCloud): Aurora will provide a quick provisioning API and an engineer (Kai) for the booth. we can also add a quick marketplace tile with one-click deploy.
Sofia (Product): talk outline suggestion: 1) what problem we solve (reliability at scale), 2) how marketplace simplifies ops, 3) customer story snippet. keep politics light.
Maya Events (Events): booth hours: Thu-Fri 9-6. recommend 2 people morning, 3 afternoon; will request video capture for the stage slot. do we want handout one-pager?
Nina (Partnerships): suggested speakers: Diego (demo), Jordan/Kai (Aurora flow), Sofia (product intro). Harper confirm?
Harper (Marketing): confirmed. I'll collate bios and write the co-branded description. also request logo files from legal.
Eli (Eng): sample provisioning call for the demo (test token in staging):
```
curl -X POST https://marketplace.aurora.example/v1/deploy \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer STAGING_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"product":"redwood-inference","variant":"edge-compact","region":"us-west-2"}'
```
Eli (Eng): note: we'll run the inference traffic through our demo proxy at demo.redwood.internal:8080. I'll add short-lived keys to 1Password path `cloudsummit/aurora`.
Jordan (Partner - AuroraCloud): Aurora will co-sponsor swag. we can do co-branded lanyards + socks + stickers. budget match 60/40 partner/Redwood.
Maya Events (Events): rough qty request: 400 stickers, 200 lanyards, 120 socks. lead time for socks = 4 weeks. shipping address: Redwood Events Ops, 410 Transit Ave, SF. drop deadline May 10.
Diego (Solutions): demo content: small customer excerpt + scripted failure to show fallback to local model. saving dataset to /demos/cloudsummit-aurora.
Sofia (Product): rehearsal request: 30-min walkthrough Wed May 15 10am PT. include slide order + 1-min handoffs. we should time each segment.
Harper (Marketing): will prepare a single-slide press blurb and social captions. legal: pls approve partner logos by Fri.
Nina (Partnerships): action items recap:
- Diego: finalize demo script + dataset (/demos/cloudsummit-aurora) by Fri
- Eli: provision demo VM + 1Password tokens + VPN details (Mon)
- Harper: bios, headshots, co-branded blurb, social kit (Mon)
- Jordan/Kai: confirm marketplace tile and partner engineer onsite (Mon)
- Maya Events: swag PO + shipping + A/V capture (Wed)
please reply with ack or changes.
Diego (Solutions): ack. I'll upload script to /demos/cloudsummit-aurora by Thu.
Eli (Eng): ack. opening ticket with infra for T4.
Harper (Marketing): ack, will ping legal for logos.
Jordan (Partner - AuroraCloud): ack. Kai arriving Wed eve. we'll share tile preview link.
artifact-bot: Created checklist: /templates/event-playbook/cloudsummit-aurora.md :white_check_mark:
Nina (Partnerships): thanks all  will send calendar invites and a brief agenda. :rocket:
